Entry.Notes: Info on how to unlock each title https://aselia.fandom.com/wiki/ToP:NDX_-_Klarth_F._Lester:_Titles

Entry.JapaneseText: ヤケ酒なんて飲んだって、何も解決なんてしない。 それがわかってても飲まずにいられない時ばかり
Entry.EnglishText: Drowning in your sorrows through drinking doesn't solve anything. But even when you know, you can't help but keep drinking.

Entry.JapaneseText: 召喚術を研究している学者。異端だと言われても、 誇りのため、信じる人たちのため、己の道を究める
Entry.EnglishText: He's a scholar researching summoning artes. Even if he's called a madman, he'll take his research to its limit for his pride and those who believe in him.

Entry.Notes: Event: Form a pact with a Spirit other than Efreet

Entry.JapaneseText: 精霊との再びの契約。だが、勘違いしてはいけない、 精霊と人との関係は対等、決して自分の力と奢るな
Entry.EnglishText: The pact has been renewed. Make no mistake however, this bond between man and spirit is that of equals. Never presume it to be your own power.

Entry.Notes: Event: Form a pact with Maxwell

Entry.JapaneseText: 四元素を司る精霊たちの統括者と、崇高なる契約を 交わして、召喚師としてはようやく一人前
Entry.EnglishText: Having forged pacts with the spirits who govern the four elements, he has become a full-fledged summoner.

Entry.Notes: Event: Form a pact with Origin

Entry.JapaneseText: この世のことわりすべてを統べる精霊王の助力を得る。 ただし、この世を思い通りにできるわけではない
Entry.EnglishText: He has gained the aid of the King of Spirits who governs the natural laws of this world. But this does not mean control over the world.

Entry.Notes: Event: make pacts with at least 7 Spirits

Entry.JapaneseText: 7体の精霊と契約完了。高らかな詠唱の声とともに 現れ出でて、敵に大ダメージ。感謝すべし
Entry.EnglishText: He has made pacts with 7 spirits. Their summoning deal enormous damage to his foes. Better be grateful.

Entry.Notes: Event: make pacts with at least all Spirits

Entry.JapaneseText: すべての精霊と契約完了。精霊たちからも一目 置かれる、高潔なる魂の持ち主
Entry.EnglishText: He has formed pacts with all the spirits. His noble soul is held in high regard, even amongst the spirits themselves.

Entry.Notes: Event: Defeat Gremlin Lair, Pluto, Flambelk, Fen Beast, Ishrantu, Justona, and Big Eye with Klarth in the party

Entry.JapaneseText: 空虚な間隙からの魔界の吠え声は、魔物すら震撼する。 だが彼は恐れない。目を開き、その姿を凛と見据える
Entry.EnglishText: The demonic howl from the void shakens monsters to their very core. Yet he fears it not - with eyes wide open, he gazes at its form with an unwavering resolve.

Entry.Notes: Event: Shop at every store with Klarth in the party

Entry.JapaneseText: お店の位置から商品の内容、質まで全部チェック。 ショッピングに関してはなかなかのうるさがた
Entry.EnglishText: From the shop's layout to its product selection and quality, he inspects it all. He's quite the stickler when it comes to shopping.

Entry.JapaneseText: 服を着てると見えないが、私、脱いだらスゴイんです。 何がって、ほら、お腹のお肉、とか……泣ける
Entry.EnglishText: You can't see it when he's dressed, but he's quite the stud with his clothes off. You know, like the belly fat and whatnot... it's beyond words.

Entry.JapaneseText: 恋人や奥様に頭が上がらない。情けないなどと言うな、 まさにこれぞ愛情と称えよう。末永くお幸せに
Entry.EnglishText: Don't say it's pathetic to be under your wife's thumb. Let's just call this true love. Wishing you a lifetime of happiness.
